title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program Payment Terms: Accepted Methods and Returned Payments
content:
**Accepted methods.** Families pay the Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program by the accepted payment methods. Cash is not accepted.

**Where a payment goes.** A payment posts to the enrollment the family names and is applied to that enrollment's oldest open charge first. A payment never moves between enrollments, siblings included.

**Returned payments.** A payment returned unpaid by the bank restores its full amount to the balance and posts one returned payment fee for that payment. A returned payment never counts as paid for late-fee or suspension purposes.

**Certified funds.** When a household has had the threshold number or more of returned payments across its Creek Kids Club enrollments within the lookback period, further payments are accepted only by online card payment or money order. The lookback period is the stated number of calendar months ending on the payment date, counted back to the same day of the month. The test is read from the household's billing histories.

## Figures by plan

| Figure (same on all six Creek Kids Club plans) | Value |
|---|---|
| Accepted payment methods | online card payment, ACH bank draft, personal check, money order |
| Returned payment fee | 30.00 per returned payment |
| Returned payments that trigger certified funds | 2 or more |
| Lookback period | 12 calendar months ending on the payment date |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical dates)

- A household had one returned check in March on one child's enrollment and one returned bank draft in November on a sibling's enrollment. A payment made the following February has 2 returns within the 12 months, counted across both enrollments, so it is accepted only by online card payment or money order.
- Move the March return 13 months back from the payment date, and only one return falls within the lookback. Any accepted method may then be used.
- A family asks to apply a payment made on one child's enrollment to a sibling's balance. The payment stays on the enrollment it was posted to.
